purpose: POC test data for the AI-Powered Advertisement Data Entry System

source_dataset.name: MAdVerse: A Hierarchical Dataset of Multi-Lingual Ads from Diverse Sources and Categories
source_dataset.licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 for annotations; underlying images belong to original publishers
source_dataset.note: Extracted from MAdVerse archives using HTTP range requests; see dataset/README.md

schema.id: unique sequential record number (1-50), matches ad_XXX_*.jpg filename prefix
schema.filename: image file name inside images/ (primary key for distinguishing records)
schema.language: language of the ad copy; parentheses note where a different language/newspaper is involved
schema.headline: main headline/tagline as printed
schema.description: short summary of the ad's subject
schema.price: all prices, discounts, EMI, interest rates or fares shown in the ad
schema.fuel_type: vehicle fuel type, where applicable; null otherwise
schema.mileage: mileage/fuel-efficiency claim, where applicable; null otherwise
schema.features: list of features, offers and selling points
schema.body_copy: supporting copy / contact details / URLs as printed (translated where noted)
schema.other_details: additional structured fields specific to the ad
schema.missing_or_uncertain: fields flagged for human verification — no values were guessed

extraction_notes: Values are transcribed from the visible artwork only; nothing was inferred as a database ID.
Regional-language ads (Odia, Hindi, Marathi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Malayalam, Gujarati, Assamese, Urdu) were translated approximately where needed and flagged in missing_or_uncertain.
Small-print figures (prices, phone numbers, fine print) may need human verification; all such cases are flagged per record.
fuel_type and mileage are null for non-vehicle ads.
